items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Ray used to call me 'Ripty' because I used to work with Ray and Hank Jones and Ella

ctx.x:
always said I'm not gonna go anyplace, you know.
So we went up to Aspen, Colorado, and you know,
some of the most enjoyable times that I have ever had in my
life was working with Oscar Peterson. Because he was really
a lot of fun, as well as Ray Brown.

But what they did to me --they believed in practical
jokes. Now we're getting ready to play at this lodge up in
Aspen, Colorado, and I can't find my snare drum. They had
taken my snare drum out of my trap case and hit it from me.
And so I'm setting up the drums and I can't find the snare
drum, and so they keep saying, Ray used to call me "Ripty"
because I used to work with Ray and Hank Jones and Ella,
and he said, "C'mon Ripty, we got to go; we got to hit it."
And I said, "I can't find my snare drum", and so I…

But I didn't know -- not knowing the practical jokes
they played. And so they started playing -- they opened up
with "Airmail Special" -- and just as fast as you could play
it, and so I had no snare drum, and all of a sudden, here comes
a waiter with a tray, my snare drum on it! Yeah, that was
really a ball I had, you know, playing with them.
